data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Terrible service.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/637e3243b84cc27618f49a02)
It took me several days to get any shipping information. The first reply, after sending 2 messages, was for a past order. I again gave the order # and ask a 3rd time. I did receive a very quick reply with an apology stating the item had shipped and would be received in several days. I received the box yesterday, and it is not as expected so I am now trying to return it. Problem is, the site says the item has not shipped! This is horrible customer service from a company that offers wonderful products. I won’t be ordering again as it is just to much of a hassle.

November 9, 2022

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Nov 23, 2022

Hello, we’re sorry to hear about this experience with us and thank you for your feedback. Our Customer Experience team reached out to you today and assisted you with a return, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
